description.value: The Langley Demonstration Garden is a public garden attraction in the Langley area of the Fraser Valley, tagged in OpenStreetMap as a leisure garden. Demonstration gardens of this type typically showcase horticultural techniques and plantings of regional interest, making them a pleasant stop for cyclists passing through the area. No further details about facilities or features could be confirmed from available sources.

With no usable website content, all amenity fields default to null and the website cannot be confirmed.
